ROOT.triggerdef: CREATE TRIGGER CDN.ProdCzynnosci_UsunPotomne ON CDN.ProdCzynnosci FOR DELETE AS begin SET NOCOUNT ON declare @lista table (PCZ_Id int, PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc int, PCZ_Proces int) insert into @lista select PCZ_Id, PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc, PCZ_Proces from deleted while 1=1 begin insert into @lista select Potomne.PCZ_Id, Potomne.PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc, Potomne.PCZ_Proces from @lista Lista inner join CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci on PTC_Ojciec=Lista.PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc and PTC_Ojciec<>0 inner join CDN.ProdCzynnosci Potomne on Potomne.PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc=PTC_Id and Potomne.PCZ_Proces=Lista.PCZ_Proces left outer join @Lista Sa on Sa.PCZ_Id=Potomne.PCZ_Id left outer join CDN.ProdCzynnosci Rodzice on Rodzice.PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc=Lista.PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc and Rodzice.PCZ_Proces=Lista.PCZ_Proces and Rodzice.PCZ_Id<>Lista.PCZ_Id and Rodzice.PCZ_Realizuje=0 where Rodzice.PCZ_Id is null and Potomne.PCZ_Realizuje<1 and Sa.PCZ_Id is null if @@RowCount=0 break end insert into @lista select CDN.ProdCzynnosci.PCZ_Id, CDN.ProdCzynnosci.PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc, CDN.ProdCzynnosci.PCZ_Proces from CDN.ProdCzynnosci inner join @lista Lista on Lista.PCZ_Id=CDN.ProdCzynnosci.PCZ_Realizuje delete CDN.ProdCzynnosci from CDN.ProdCzynnosci inner join @lista Lista on Lista.PCZ_Id=CDN.ProdCzynnosci.PCZ_Id left outer join deleted on deleted.PCZ_Id=CDN.ProdCzynnosci.PCZ_Id where deleted.PCZ_Id is null SET NOCOUNT OFF end
